beats.say: Tetris has sold 520 million copies, far more than the entire population of the UK.
Alexey Pajitnov created the game in the mid 1980s in his spare time.
He programmed it in about three weeks, a time span like a short working week.
Copies were shared freely on floppy disks in Moscow before spreading to the West.
Nintendo released it in 1989, and it helped make the Game Boy a global success.
That was Player One, so subscribe to catch the next one. Tetris sold 520 million copies.

facts: Tetris has sold 520 million copies as of 2022.
Alexey Pajitnov created Tetris in the mid 1980s.
He initially programmed it in Pascal for the Elektronika 60 in about three weeks.
Floppy disk copies were distributed freely throughout Moscow before spreading to Eastern Europe.
Henk Rogers negotiated with Elektronorgtechnica to license Tetris to Nintendo for the Game Boy and Nintendo Entertainment System.
Both the Game Boy and NES versions were released in 1989.
The Game Boy release contributed to its console's success and popularized Tetris.
